command: node --input-type=module -e import { spawn } from "node:child_process"; import { once } from "node:events"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const child = spawn(process.execPath, ["dist/src/main.js"], {env:{...process.env,DATABASE_URL:process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL,PORT:"0"},stdio:["ignore","pipe","pipe"]}); let error = ""; child.stderr.on("data", data => error += data); const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 10000); const exited = once(child,"exit"); try { const ready = await Promise.race([once(child.stdout,"data").then(([data]) => String(data)), exited.then(() => {throw new Error(error || "Exited before listening");})]); assert.match(ready,/Agent backend listening/); child.kill("SIGTERM"); const [code] = await exited; assert.equal(code,0,error); console.log("Compiled backend startup and graceful shutdown passed"); } finally {clearTimeout(timer); if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill("SIGKILL");}
